propositions: rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice with hardcoded provider string checks at multiple sites (runner.py:268,316; structured.py:46; runner.py:653) that prevent real multi-provider support
AWS Bedrock-hosted Claude has no native support path in rebar, only OpenAI-compatible gateways which lose prompt caching, tenacity retries, per-request timeouts, and native structured output
provider_factory hook and ModelProfile capability detection should replace all provider-name string matching, making provider selection a first-class concern instead of special-cased branching

signed verdict sidecars must record structured provider provenance (provider name, endpoint host, support tier, effective capabilities) rather than a model string that no longer identifies what answered

Bedrock and direct-Anthropic should form two tiers: first-class with native builders and full feature coverage, best-effort for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with tiered degradation explicitly documented
REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY configuration already documented but rejected at runtime should compose with REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER to enable custom endpoints through the best-effort tier
